task: submit a connector to the directory
definition: File the connector through the submission portal and accept the directory terms.
outcome: the submission has been filed through the portal with the directory terms accepted, and the connector is queued for review

records.outcome: a remote MCP server, including an MCP App, has been filed through the submission portal with all seven policy acknowledgments given, and is queued for review
preconditions: directory management access: Owner, or a custom role with the Directory or Libraries permission
documentation URL, privacy policy URL, icon, and test account credentials ready
carousel screenshots if submitting an MCP App
steps: Open the submission portal in your organization's settings on Claude.ai
Read the Introduction step on what a directory listing does and does not do
In Connection, confirm the https:// server URL, the transport, and whether users reach the server by Universal URL, Multiple URLs, or a URL pattern
In Tools, let tools, prompts, and resources sync, and fix any tools flagged for missing titles or annotations on your server
In Listing, enter server name, tagline, description, one to five categories, documentation and privacy policy URLs, support contact, icon, and URL slug
In Use cases, describe the primary use cases, what users need before connecting, and whether the connector reads, writes, or both
In Company, give company name and website plus a primary contact for review updates
In Authentication, choose OAuth, a custom connection, or no authentication, within the limits your Connection choice imposes
In Data handling, state whether the API is your own, proxied with permission, or a third party's, and whether health data or sponsored content is involved
In Test & launch, give test-account setup and access instructions and confirm you have run every tool via MCP Inspector or as a custom connector in Claude
In Compliance, give all seven policy acknowledgments
Read through the Review step and submit

evidence.anchor: ### What to expect in the portal
evidence.quote: The portal walks you through the following steps. Your progress saves automatically in your browser as you move between steps

records.notes: The portal accepts remote MCP servers only; the URL slug is permanent once published.

records.outcome: a desktop extension (MCPB) has been filed for directory listing through the separate submission form, without using the organization portal
preconditions: the local MCP server is packaged as an MCPB
no portal or organization access required
steps: Open the desktop extension submission form at clau.de/desktop-extention-submission
File the desktop extension through that form
